name: agent-monitor
description: Claude Code 与 Codex CLI 单轮停止声音提醒
author: Agent Monitor Contributors

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run test && electron-vite build
scripts.build:win: npm run build:hook:win && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis --publish never
scripts.build:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.mac-local.yml --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.build:mac:release: node scripts/validate-mac-release.cjs && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.mac-release.yml --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
